caption:
Ever feel priced by how useful you are? You were never someone's transaction. (Amos 1:9 devotional)

To sell trust is no small thing; a person is never a price to be paid. You are loved by One who would never sell you.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where am I weighing people — or fearing I'm being weighed — by usefulness?
